## Scope

- Gate Card / requirement / ADR:
- Non-goals respected:

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added/updated
- [ ] `py -3 scripts/check_docs.py`
- [ ] Compile, full pytest, CLI audit and Workspace Chat import pass
- [ ] Git diff checks pass

## Privacy and operational review

- [ ] No private runtime data, credential, raw prompt/document or screenshot is included
- [ ] Threat/privacy/dependency/migration impact assessed
- [ ] Rollback and residual risk documented
- [ ] Roadmap, handover and changelog updated when required
